requirements.title: Valid electrical licence
requirements.description: Bidder must be a valid Electrical licence holder (MV or Above); copies of the valid Electrical License issued or endorsed by ELBO, Odisha must be uploaded.

requirements.title: Similar-work experience threshold
requirements.description: Bidder must have completed, in the last seven years ending on the tender-submission deadline, either three similar works of at least 40% of estimated cost each, two similar works of at least 60% each, or one similar work of at least 80%. Similar work means supply and installation of various types of pump motor sets.
requirements.evidenceText: “Three (03) similar works each of value not less than 40% (i.e. for Rs. 16,14,234.00/-) ... or Two (02) similar works each of value not less than 60% (i.e. for Rs. 24,21,352.00/-) ... or one (01) similar work of value not less than 80% (i.e. for Rs 32,28,469.00/-) ... in last 07 (Seven) Years ending last date of tender submission.” “The similar work means, ‘Supply and Installation of various types of Pump Motor Sets’”
requirements.extractedValue: 3 works ≥ Rs. 16,14,234 each; or 2 works ≥ Rs. 24,21,352 each; or 1 work ≥ Rs. 32,28,469

requirements.title: Eligible experience sources
requirements.description: Similar-work experience must be from Central Government, State Government, PSU, or Autonomous Body.
requirements.evidenceText: “The experience of similar work should be from Central Govt., State Govt., PSU and Autonomous Body.”

requirements.title: Average annual turnover
requirements.description: Average annual financial turnover for the last three years ending 31 March 2025 must exceed 50% of the estimated cost.
requirements.evidenceText: “Average Annual Financial, the turnover during the last 3 years, ending 31st March 2025 should be more than 50% of the estimated cost.”
requirements.extractedValue: More than 50% of estimated cost

requirements.title: CA-certified turnover certificate
requirements.description: Upload an affidavit or certificate from a Chartered Accountant stating financial turnover for the specified period; further details may be requested after technical-bid opening.
requirements.evidenceText: “Certificate of financial turn over of last 3 years duly certified from CA: At the time of submission of bid, bidder may upload affidavit/ certificate from CA mentioning finance turn over for the period specified in the bid document.”
requirements.extractedValue: Financial turnover certificate/affidavit certified by CA for last 3 years

requirements.title: EMD submission
requirements.description: Submit EMD equal to 2% of estimated value by DD, PBG, or FDR; upload the scanned copy and submit original DD with technical-bid documents. Bids without EMD demand drafts will be rejected. EMD exemption is not allowed.
requirements.evidenceText: “The bidder shall be required to submit the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) for an amount of 2% of Estimate value by way of DD/PBG/FDR. Scanned Copy of the Demand Drafts must be uploaded and the original DD must be submitted with the Technical Bid documents. Bid(s) received in tender without Demand Drafts of EMD will be rejected.”
requirements.extractedValue: 2% of estimated value; DD/PBG/FDR

requirements.title: No EMD exemption
requirements.description: EMD exemption is not permitted for this work.

requirements.title: Performance guarantee
requirements.description: Successful contractor must furnish performance guarantee equal to 5% of contract value, as FDR or bank guarantee from a scheduled bank, valid for six months beyond completion of all contractual obligations. Failure to deposit it can result in EMD forfeiture.
requirements.evidenceText: “The successful contractor will be required to furnish a Performance guarantee of 05% (Five Percent) of Contract Value ... in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt or Bank Guarantee from any Scheduled Bank ... valid for a period of 6 months beyond completion of all the contractual obligations. In case the contractor fails to deposit the said performance guarantee ... the EMD will be forfeited.”

redFlags.description: The stated completion period is inconsistent: the tender overview states 60 days, while the penalty clause states all work must be completed within one month from issue of the work order.
redFlags.evidenceText: “All the work shall be completed within One Month from the date of issue of work Order by the Institute.”

redFlags.description: Original EMD must be physically delivered by 31 May 2026 at 16:00, after the online submission deadline of 30 May 2026 at 18:00; a bidder should ensure compliance with both deadlines.
redFlags.evidenceText: Online submission is due “By 30/05/2026 at 18:00 Hours,” while original EMD is “To be submitted by 31/05/2026 by 16.00 hours.”

redFlags.description: EMD exemption is expressly disallowed, and failure to provide the required EMD can lead to rejection.
redFlags.evidenceText: “EMD Exemption is not allowed for this work.”

redFlags.description: Delay penalty is 2% per month, computed on a per-day basis, capped at 10% of total tender value.
redFlags.evidenceText: “a penalty at the Rate of 2% per month of delay to be computed on per day basis shall be levied subject to maximum of 10% of the total tender value.”

redFlags.description: AIIMS reserves the right to reject any or all bids without assigning reasons, including the lowest bid.
redFlags.evidenceText: “The Executive Director, AIIMS, Bhubaneswar does not bind itself to accept the lowest or any other bid and reserves to itself the authority to reject any or all the bids received without the assignment of any reason.”

redFlags.description: Non-compliance with contract terms may result in bid rejection at any stage and suspension of the firm for one year, with nothing payable by AIIMS.
redFlags.evidenceText: “the Competent Authority, will have the right to reject the bid at any stage without assigning any reason thereof and nothing will be payable by AIIMS, Bhubaneswar in that event the firm shall be suspended for One Year.”

redFlags.description: The scope deems any facility not mentioned but considered vital to the work as included, creating potential scope ambiguity without extra payment.
redFlags.evidenceText: “Any facility not mentioned in this scope, but which is vital... Are assumed to be included in the scope of work.”

redFlags.description: No compensation is payable for damage caused by listed natural calamities; the contractor must make good damage at its own cost.
redFlags.evidenceText: “No compensation shall be payable to the contractor for any damage caused by rains lightening, wind, storm, floods Tornado, earth quakes or other natural calamities... He shall make good all such damages at his own cost.”

redFlags.description: Engineer-in-Charge/security/local-authority restrictions must be followed, with no extra payment and no delay claim.
redFlags.evidenceText: “the contractor shall be bound to follow all such restrictions/instruction & nothing extra shall be payable on this account & no claim for delay on this account shall be entertained.”

redFlags.description: Failure to furnish the prescribed performance guarantee may result in debarment from AIIMS tenders for one year; failure to commence work can result in absolute forfeiture of performance guarantee.
redFlags.evidenceText: “If I/We, fail to furnish the prescribed Performance Guarantee... be at liberty to debarred my firm from AIIMS tender for one year.” “if I/We fail to commence work... be at liberty to forfeit the said performance guarantee absolutely.”

redFlags.description: Back-to-back execution of eligible similar work can lead to perpetual debarment, and before start of work can lead to forfeiture of the entire performance guarantee.
redFlags.evidenceText: “if such a violation comes to the notice of Department, then I/we shall be debarred for bidding in future forever... before date of start of work, the Engineer-in-Charge shall be free to forfeit the entire amount of Performance Guarantee”

redFlags.description: The Integrity Pact permits forfeiture of the entire Performance Guarantee and Security Deposit following specified disqualification or termination circumstances.
redFlags.evidenceText: “may in its considered opinion forfeit the entire amount of Performance Guarantee and Security Deposit of the Bidder/Contractor.”

redFlags.description: Disputes or differences under the Integrity Pact are expressly excluded from arbitration.
redFlags.evidenceText: “any dispute or difference arising between the parties with regard to the terms of this Agreement/Pact... shall not be subject to arbitration.”

redFlags.description: BOQ quantities are expressly tentative and may increase or decrease according to site requirements.
redFlags.evidenceText: "Quantity mentioned above is tentative, it may increase or decrease as per site requirement."

redFlags.description: The contractor has no claim if required to use only the Engineer-In-Charge-approved material sample.
redFlags.evidenceText: "The contractor has to use material of that approved sample only. No claim in this regard shall be entertained."

redFlags.description: Mismatch between physical EMD instrument details, scanned copy, and online-entered data will cause rejection of the uploaded bid.
redFlags.evidenceText: "Otherwise the uploaded bid will be rejected."

redFlags.description: Modification of the provided BoQ file by the bidder will cause bid rejection.
redFlags.evidenceText: "If the BoQ file is found to be modified by the bidder, the bid will be rejected."
